note: Editor corrections made after the first unseen-domain run (post-hoc): applied with APPLY_POLICY_CHANGE after every recorded upload. `python -m asof.eval.unseen.onboard --first-run-policy` leaves them out and rebuilds the policy the first run checked.

changes.clause_text: Use the passenger's base fare and class. The table gives the cancellation CHARGE, not the refund. Refund = max(0, base fare minus charge). For any flat charge, deduct no more than the passenger's base fare. No refund of base fare is due when T is below the last threshold, including after departure. The booking service fee is not refunded under this clause. CLASS T >= 48 h 12 <= T < 48 h 4 <= T < 12 h T < 4 h AC First (1A) INR 240 INR 120 50% of base fare No refund AC Two Tier (2A) INR 200 INR 100 50% of base fare No refund Sleeper (SL) INR 120 INR 60 50% of base fare No refund Second Sitting (2S) INR 60 INR 30 50% of base fare No refund

changes.clause_text: No voluntary refund is available for a confirmed Premium QuickBook ticket at any time before or after departure. This special rule replaces P-03 for a confirmed PQ passenger regardless of 1A, 2A, SL, or 2S class. An unconfirmed PQ waitlisted passenger instead follows P-06. A booking becomes PQ only if sold explicitly under the PQ quota; paying a high fare alone does not make it PQ. E1 and E2 can override the confirmed-PQ rule, and E3 can override it only where that version expressly permits.
